answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 40 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The delta register is checked at draw time, willow lists the eligible set, and beacon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 40 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. The fee repeats 28 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
